pages.text: Near a Nether Star, aether stops trying to fade. Solid clusters grow around the nucleus. The star remains through each crystallization, and the glimmer finally gains a lasting form.

pages.title: Feed the crystal
pages.text: Place beside a reservoir or connect a pulse or resonance branch. It grows crystalline fragments on its own, commonly up to four each second.$(br2)A fragment usually stores 200 and spends another 200 becoming stable. Empty-hand use takes one; sneak-use takes all. Hoppers collect the output, and growth pauses at a full stack.

pages.title: Save a fading fragment
pages.text: Toss a still-living fragment onto the top. The nucleus stabilizes it, spending only the extra processing aether.$(br2)Collect it from the same output. This chamber grows crystals; portable jars belong in liquid reservoirs.
